places.rationale: The strongest state, lowest debt and highest income here, with heavy AI use and global capital in pharma and finance; aging and finance jobs exposed to AI are the main weak points.

places.rationale: Very poor, with little power, clean water or food security and high climate vulnerability, so even modest growth counts as better, but a weak state and a civil-war past keep collapse risk high.

places.rationale: An indebted oil state with very weak governance, wide hunger and an aging ruler, whose oil rent fades over the century; water is plentiful but the state is the weak link.

places.rationale: An EU and NATO member with low debt and fair AI use, but a shrinking, aging population, high inequality and chronic political fragmentation; its consumption figure looks high for its GDP.

places.rationale: Security has improved sharply under an increasingly unchecked government, but heavy debt service, remittance dependence, rising water stress and hurricanes limit growth.

places.rationale: The best-run state here with the highest AI use and large sovereign wealth; reliance on imported food and energy, sea-level rise and a large low-wage migrant workforce are what hold it back.

places.rationale: A top-rated state with low debt, high AI use and a welfare system that spreads gains evenly, which matters for the nine-in-ten abundance bar; aging is the main drag.

places.rationale: An educated, AI-using population held back by a collapsed financial system, war with Israel, a sectarian state and extreme water stress; recovery from a low point is possible but fragile.
